$description: Details (platform/components/Details, library wave 5, lane B): its component tokens. The native details and summary, in three variants: default, bordered and inline.

details-font-size.$description: Details: the body size (summary and content).

details-summary-hover-background.$description: Details: the summary under the pointer (the hover fill, as a ghost button).

details-summary-radius.$description: Details: the corner of the summary's hover fill and focus ring.

details-summary-font-weight.$description: Details: the summary's weight, so it reads as the thing to press.

details-summary-gap.$description: Details: the gap between the chevron and the label.

details-summary-min-height.$description: Details: the summary is at least the inline-action height (a 24px target).

details-content-margin-block-start.$description: Details: the space between the summary and the content.

details-content-indent.$description: Details: the content starts under the label (the chevron and its gap).

details-focus-outline-color.$description: Details: the summary's focus ring color.

details-focus-outline-width.$description: Details: the summary's focus ring width.

details-focus-outline-offset.$description: Details: the summary's focus ring offset.

details-bordered-border-width.$description: Bordered details: the box's border width.

details-bordered-radius.$description: Bordered details: the box's corner (the card corner).

details-bordered-summary-min-height.$description: Bordered details: the summary row is the standard control height.

details-bordered-padding-inline.$description: Bordered details: the box's side padding.

details-bordered-padding-block.$description: Bordered details: the space under the content.

details-bordered-content-indent.$description: Bordered details: the content starts under the label (the padding, the chevron and its gap).

details-bordered-summary-radius.$description: Bordered details: the summary row's hover fill is square inside the box.

details-inline-summary-hover-text.$description: Inline details: the summary under the pointer.

details-inline-summary-font-weight.$description: Inline details: the summary's regular weight.

details-inline-summary-gap.$description: Inline details: the gap between the chevron and the label.

details-inline-content-margin-block-star.$description: Inline details: the space between the summary and the content.
